watches.name: Walid Benla x MINIM MN01 "Arabian Nights"
watches.description: Created in collaboration with Walid Benla, writer and founder of Time-Telling Magazine, the MN01 “Arabian Nights” is a celebration of storytelling, heritage, and the friendships forged through a shared passion for watchmaking. At its centre lies a green aventurine dial, whose shimmering and sparkling surface recalls the lush oasis hidden beyond desert sands. Long associated with prosperity, opportunity, and good fortune, green felt a fitting choice for a watch inspired by timeless tales and new beginnings. The side case has “لكل وقتٍ أذان” marked, which translates to “every time has its call”, a constant reminder that time offers no guarantees, only opportunities. The rest is ours to embrace and seize. Limited to just 33 pieces, a number regarded as particularly fortunate across much of the Arab world, Arabian Nights honours a rich tradition of stories passed from one generation to the next. Technical specifications Dimensions Case diameter: 36.5mm (excluding crown) Crown diameter: 6mm Case height: 9.75mm (including flat sapphire crystal) Lug to lug: 43.5mm Lug width: 20mm Dial Green aventurine central and sub-seconds dial Outter CNC guilloche ring Materials Case: 316L stainless steel Crystal: Flat sapphire crystal with anti-fingerprint and anti-reflective coating Strap: Dark grey babele leather strap by HasNoBounds with burgundy matched contrast stitching Buckle: 316L brushed stainless steel with laser-engraved MINIM logo Movement Sellita SW 261-1M: Manual-wind, D1 finishing, Élaboré-grade accuracy, Hacking small seconds at 6 o’clock Water Resistance 5 ATM Packaging Wooden presentation box with paper sleeve Exclusive velvet dust bag Pricing UK: £1,299 (including VAT) Rest of World: £1,299 (excluding VAT and import charges) Shipping: Scheduled to ship November - December 2026

watches.name: MINIM x MIC MN01 (back order for Q4'26 delivery)
watches.description: This product is currently on back order as the current build batch has SOLD OUT. The next production batch is scheduled for late Q4 2026, with pieces shipping as soon as they are ready. Please note that delivery timing may be subject to minor production delays. Every watch has a beginning. This one begins with a community. Before MINIM took its first real steps, before prototypes and production, there were conversations. Late nights spent discussing proportions, movements, design philosophies. Questions, opinions, encouragement. Much of that happened within Micro Indy Collective, a space where collectors, independent brand owners, and enthusiasts come together simply for the love of watches. It is a place where ideas are challenged, refined, and sometimes quietly set into motion. The MINIM × MIC MN01 is a tribute to that beginning. Created to celebrate the second anniversary of Micro Indy Collective, this piece marks a moment that feels both personal and shared. It is a recognition that no independent journey is truly taken alone, and that behind every brand, there is often a group of people who believed in it early, shaped it in subtle ways, and helped it find its footing. The dial is rendered in black and gold, the colours of the Collective. Black brings depth and restraint, while gold introduces warmth and quiet confidence. Together, they reflect the character of the community itself, thoughtful, passionate, and grounded in a shared appreciation for craft. This is not simply a collaboration. It is a thank you. A way to honour the conversations, the support, and the collective spirit that helped MINIM become what it is today. Key Features: Extremely limited production: 25 pieces (all marked with 1 of 25) At the heart of the MN01 lies an appreciation for the artistry of the dial. Each variant showcases intricate CNC guilloché patterns, recalling the storied traditions of decorative watchmaking. Specs: Case: Gold DLC coated case Diameter: 36.5mm Height: 9.75mm (incl. MINIM is pleased to unveil 嬌 (Giu1), a Lunar New Year special edition limited to 50 pieces, created in celebration of the Year of the Horse. Deeply personal in nature, 嬌 draws from my upbringing in Hong Kong, where Lunar New Year was defined by family reunions, shared meals, and the colour red — a symbol of joy, renewal, and protection.
